sentences.en: Ansari Lari extended, on behalf of the local government of Fars and people, a warm welcome to President Jiang Zemin for his visit to Shiraz, Fars.

sentences.en: In the Han Dynasty(206BC---220AD), "Lari" fell on the day three weeks after Winter Solstice, which was actually hard to pin down or remember.

sentences.en: On April 19, 2002, President Jiang Zemin, on a state visit to Iran, met with Governor-General Mohammad Ebrahim Ansari Lari of Fars at the hotel Jiang stayed.
